dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains stormwater infiltration facilities. These facilities consist of shallow excavated areas, that are backfilled with course stone aggregate allowing for the temporary storage of runoff in the void spaces of the material. Discharge of this stored runoff occurs through infiltration into the surrounding soil.

Please be advised that these records are based upon available information, compiled from a variety of sources, some of which has not been verified. This is not a plan of survey, field verification is recommended.
